candidates.title: In-cycle projected-residual exit for restarted GMRES, confirmed by one true residual per stage solve, at the unchanged stage target
candidates.mechanism: Production GMRES(40), GCRO-DR and LGMRES build every restart cycle to full length and test convergence only on the true residual between cycles (gmres.rs:110-186, :350-366; gmres_into.rs:237-262; gcrodr.rs:1006-1072). On 320 frozen Bruss-50 stage solves every iterating solve used 40/40 columns and finished typically 4-5 decades below threshold (krylov.md 0.1, L-0046 data). Proposal: track the Givens-updated least-squares residual |g_{k+1}| per column; when it falls below thr = max(atol, rtol*||b||) (scaled by beta/||r_true|| under left preconditioning) form x_k and compute ONE true residual b - W x_k; stop if it passes (its W x_k is then the exact image reused by KRY-SHARED-SPACE and the r_i used by CERT-OSA-STALL), otherwise continue the cycle with the check gap doubled (gmres_givens.rs:432-453 logic). Target and true-residual certificate are unchanged; the stage solutions change only by less overshoot. This is the enabling lever: while cycles are always full, no looser forcing (INO-FORCE-ABS) can save a single column.
candidates.robustness_effect: Neutral by construction: same threshold, same true-residual certificate, no new acceptance path. Final stage residuals sit nearer the 1e-10 relative target instead of 4-5 decades below it, so any accuracy change is bounded by what the existing target already admits. Only new failure mode: a projected/true residual gap (FD-JVP nonlinearity at sqrt(eps), rounding) costs extra true-residual checks, never a false certificate.
candidates.speed_effect: Replica decomposition (INO lens, hyp/mfrep.py mode 'proj', which reproduces SPD07 BASE exactly): JVP per accepted step at the unchanged 1e-10 target Bruss-50 0.62/0.47/0.30x at outer rtol 1e-3/1e-6/1e-8; Bruss-160 0.73/0.62x at 1e-6/1e-8. Independent corroboration (probe_shared.py 'full' arm = unrestarted exact-stop + 1 true residual): Bruss-50 329 -> 157 JVP/attempt (0.48x). The saving grows at tight outer rtol because smaller h needs fewer columns while cycles stay at 40. For n <= 8 the measured 0.71-0.75x is almost entirely the duplicate final residual, which is programming-level (see dropped).
candidates.assumptions: Givens residual equals the true residual in exact arithmetic (unpreconditioned or right-preconditioned; left preconditioning needs the beta/||r_true|| rescale); JVPs linear in v (AD, or FD at a frozen base point); zero initial guess (L-0084: Zero cheapest in 14/14); threshold stays relative to ||b|| until INO-FORCE-ABS changes it.
candidates.predictions: Rust GMRES-into with an in-cycle exit, SPD07 export_base, nothing else changed: (1) final relative error and accepted/rejected sequences equal to base within +-1 step in 14/14 cells; (2) JVP per accepted step Bruss-50 374 -> <= 190 at 1e-6 and 342 -> <= 115 at 1e-8; Bruss-160 694 -> <= 520 at 1e-6 and 412 -> <= 270 at 1e-8; (3) mean true-residual checks per stage solve <= 1.2; (4) zero new linear failures; (5) n <= 8 rows change only by the removed duplicate matvec.
candidates.discriminating_probe: Replica (minutes): mfrep.py modes base vs proj on Bruss-50/160 at 1e-6/1e-8, logging every (projected, true) residual pair at exit; KILL if true/projected > 10 on more than 1% of exits (the gap would eat the gain). Rust (half a day): in-cycle exit in gmres_into reusing gmres_givens.rs:376-453; run SPD07 export_base (17 s). PASS: Bruss-50 JVP <= 0.55x at 1e-6 with counts and errors unchanged. KILL: < 1.3x reduction on both Brusselators, or any accept/reject sequence change beyond +-1 step.
candidates.fatal_vulnerability: Its gain is exactly the overshoot of unpreconditioned restarted GMRES; any lever that makes solves short (PC-LAGGED-HWINDOW at 5-9 columns, KRY-SHARED-SPACE saturation at small n) removes it. With FD-JVPs the Arnoldi relation is perturbed at sqrt(eps) relative, so near a 1e-10 relative target the projected residual may systematically undershoot and force repeated true-residual checks.

candidates.title: Tolerance-consistent absolute WRMS stage targets for the U-form matrix-free driver, with single-pass order-consistent (err/e_ref)^{6/5} scaling and an absolute U8 fidelity floor
candidates.mechanism: Replace the fixed relative target 1e-10*||rhs_U||_2 (rodas5p_matrix_free_fast.rs:35, :475-480; the U-form driver has no forcing) by absolute targets in the solver's own WRMS metric D = diag(1/(atol + rtol|y|)). (i) Allocation: eps_i = theta*phi/(8*max(tau_y,i, tau_e,i)), where tau is the sup over Re z <= 0 of the residual-to-output transfer functions T_y,i = (b_code^T L(z)^-1)_i, T_e,i = (L(z)^-1)_{8,i}, L(z) = (1 - g z)I - g(zA + C) (re-verified from hyp/tau_table.npz: tau_y = [1.73, 0.51, 6.25, 6.08, 3.82, 4.77, 1.01, 1.00], sum 25.2; tau_e sum 14.2; sums 30/19 at a = 0.5 and 38/28 at a = 1). Since sum_i tau_i eps_i <= theta*phi, solve contamination of y_new and err is bounded by theta*phi tolerance units for normal dissipative J. (ii) Order consistency: phi = min(1, e_hat/e_ref)^{6/5}, with e_hat the controller-predicted error, e_ref ~ 0.5 (I-controller equilibrium 0.59), a conservative e_hat = 1e-6 on the first step and after large-h rejections, and a single pass; a second pass only if err_c << e_hat and B_y > theta*phi(err_c). This is the U-form, pass-free version of WU-3's min(1, err)^{(p+1)/(q+1)}. (iii) U8 floor: b_code_8 = 1 and A[8,:7] = b_code[:7] (re-verified), so y_new = Y_8 + U_8 and err = ||U_8||_w carry U8's solve error with weight 1; set eps_8 = min(theta/8, kappa*e_sat), e_sat = (0.9/5)^5 = 1.9e-4, kappa ~ 0.1, so err_c is never returned as an exact 0 that triggers maximal growth. Rationale: a relative target gives an absolute stage error ~ eta*h||f||_w/tol, over-solving at loose tol (and unreachable within 200 columns on nonnormal advection, which produces linear failures) and under-solving at tight tol (Wang-Yu order loss reproduced as this inconsistency). It pays only on top of KRY-PROJ-STOP.
candidates.robustness_effect: Replica: uniform relative forcing at eta = 1e-4 (Wang-Yu style) is catastrophic (Bruss-50 1e-6 final error 11.4x base with 1.4x steps; HIRES and Robertson at 1e-6 hit the 20000-attempt cap; vdp 29-42x), while absolute targets at theta = 0.001 keep final errors within 1.3x base on Bruss-50, HIRES and Robertson at 1e-3/1e-6/1e-8 with unchanged rejection counts (vdp at 1e-3 is trajectory noise, 1.7-27 rtol across 24 inner variants). On heat + upwind advection (n = 64) the fixed 1e-10 arm has 22/23/25 linear-failure rejections per run; absolute targets alone give 0/3/11. Fixed-step ladders: without phi the error floors at ~1e-9 (heat 1e4) and 3e-8..3e-7 (order-reducing vector PR); with (err/0.5)^{6/5} and the conservative first step the ladder equals direct LU at every rung (4.73e-8 -> 1.79e-14). U8 floor: accepted steps with err_c = 0 drop from 4-23 to 0-4 per run. Negative control: loosening U8 relative to ||b_8|| (kappa = 0.1) is 50-557x worse on HIRES and vdp.
candidates.speed_effect: Total with projected stop (theta = 0.001, err^{1.2}, U8 floor, certified): JVP/accepted Bruss-50 0.40/0.35/0.27x at 1e-3/1e-6/1e-8; HIRES 0.75/0.69/0.65x; Robertson 0.71/0.69/0.67x; vdp 0.74x. INCREMENTAL over KRY-PROJ-STOP alone, computed from the same replica decomposition: Bruss-50 0.65/0.74/0.90x; n <= 8 about 0.9-1.0x. The raw 2.5-5x headline (Bruss-50 0.20-0.24x, Bruss-160 0.39-0.41x) needs theta = 0.02, which HIRES refutes. The order scaling costs +1-4% adaptive in the (err/0.5) form (+6-26% for plain err^{6/5}). Krylov-lens corroboration of absolute targets: in the shared space a step-scaled target (1e-10*||b_1||) cuts heat-200 new directions from 93.4 to 34.4 per attempt while y_new moves <= 1.2e-5 tolerance units, because late stages (RHS-norm ratios 0.044/0.0027/1e-4 for stages 6-8) stop paying a full relative solve.
candidates.assumptions: First-order frozen-J transfer; tau assumes normal J and mu_D(J) <= 0 (false on vdp at 119/351 accepted steps, yet accuracy held empirically; CERT-OSA-STALL adds h*mu shifts); err ~ h^5 for the 6/5 exponent (over-tightens safely under order reduction); the controller exposes e_hat; the replica GMRES minimizes the D-scaled residual whereas production minimizes L2 and tests WRMS through residual_scale (expected small effect where D is near-uniform); a single global theta.

candidates.title: Online first-order certified one-sided acceptance err_c +- B_e(h*mu_hat) from the stage true residuals, extended to accept stalled Krylov stages
candidates.mechanism: After the 8 stages compute B_e = sum_i tau_e,i(a)||r_i||_w and B_y = sum_i tau_y,i(a)||r_i||_w, where r_i are the true stage residuals already computed for certification (0 extra JVP), a = h*mu_hat and mu_hat >= mu_D(J) = lambda_max of the symmetric part of D J D^-1 in the solver's WRMS metric, so ||(I - h g J)^-1||_D <= 1/(1 - h g mu) and the maximum-modulus constants tau(a) on Re z <= a apply (tau sums 25.2/14.2 at a = 0, 30/19 at 0.5, 38/28 at 1, 89/146 at 2, 1601/2829 at 3; pole at 1/g = 4.72). Rule: accept iff err_c + B_e <= 1 and B_y <= theta_cap; reject iff err_c - B_e > 1; otherwise reject or re-solve the largest contributor. INO-FORCE-ABS sizes the a priori targets from the same tau(a), so the unresolved band is at most theta wide. For a >= ~3 fall back to the tight target, labelled uncertified. Sources of mu_hat: small n, assemble J with n JVPs; declared band or colors, Gershgorin on the D-symmetrized part; otherwise a declared bound, else EstimateOnly (Ritz values only give lower bounds). Stall extension: a stage that misses eps_i (budget reached, or < 1 decade per cycle) no longer raises CoreError::LinearSolve -> reject with 0.2; the iterate and its true residual enter the certificate, so a mildly stalled stage becomes a quantified error contribution and hopeless solves stop early. Replaces the K-form refinement passes (sequential.rs:677-722) and the computed-but-ignored Underresolved flag (integrate.rs:819).
candidates.robustness_effect: Replica: without log-norm shifts the first-order bound fails on accepted steps (vdp 34/115 at 1e-3 and 119/351 at 1e-6, under-estimating by up to 7x; median h*mu_D 5.6/1.95 at violating steps while h*max Re lambda <= 0.84, i.e. nonnormality; HIRES 1-2/204, worst 1.26x). With exact mu_D shifts there are ZERO violations of |err_c - err*| <= B_e and ||dy||_w <= B_y on every accepted step for Bruss-50, HIRES, vdp and Robertson (1e-3, 1e-6), heat lambda_max 1e4/1e6 and heat + upwind a = 60/150/300 (run8, run9, run11), with 0 unresolved accepts. Stall extension on heat + upwind (n = 64, mu_2 ~ -7, cond(W) ~ 100): linear-failure rejections 22/23/25 (fixed 1e-10) -> 0/3/11 (certified forcing) -> 0 in all 6 runs (stall-certified) with 0 violations. An under-resolved step can no longer be accepted on its inexact estimate alone.
candidates.speed_effect: Certification at equal theta: +0-1% JVP (Bruss-50 1e-6, vdp, Robertson), +5% (Bruss-50 1e-3), +9-10% (HIRES); Gershgorin mu instead of exact: +1-7% on Bruss-50 (h*mu_G median 0.35-1.08, max 3.28, no fallbacks). Stall extension, JVP/accepted: a = 60 rtol 1e-4 1090 -> 366 (0.34x); a = 150 1170 -> 446 (0.38x; certified forcing alone 555); a = 300 rtol 1e-7 1459 -> 827 (0.57x); a = 300 rtol 1e-4 1198 -> 1065 at higher but in-tolerance error (0.24 rtol vs base 0.0002). Matched error at a = 60: base at rtol 1e-4 reaches 2e-7 with 33.8k JVPs; stall-certified at rtol 1e-7 reaches 1.5e-8 with 12.9k (0.38x the work for a 13x smaller error). Against the protected K-form path (+52/+57% JVP/attempt on PR/quadratic-4 from refinement passes, L-0038) a single certified pass is predicted to remove most of that overhead.
candidates.assumptions: First-order frozen-J linearization of the stage chain (the rigorous interval version resolves all acceptances, L-0062, but blows up on wild attempts, L-0049: B = 2e122; replica violations occurred only on attempts with err ~ 800-1000, rejected anyway). mu_hat must be a true upper bound (no JVP-only route; needs J^T or structure). WRMS weights frozen per attempt, plus the weight-change term (term_scale, rnext01_residual_output.py:264). For the stall extension: stagnation occurs at residual levels whose transfer bound is affordable, and GMRES restarts from the current iterate.

Rust: instrument the U-form driver to emit per-attempt (err_c, ||r_i||_w, h, y); recompute err* offline with tools/rnext01_residual_output.py (frozen J, exact solves). KILL: any accepted non-blown-up step violating 1.01 B_e plus roundoff under exact mu_D (first-order model wrong), or Gershgorin fallback > 20% on Brusselator. Stall arm: GMRES returns 'stalled: x, r' and acceptance uses the rule; run the atlas semilinear family and the R-NEXT-03 held-out CDR operators wrapped as y' = (D2 - Pe D1)y (cold GMRES fails 256/384 there). KILL stall: certified acceptances violating the exact-chain bound offline, or no attempt reduction. SAVE: 0 violations, certified cost <= 1.15x uncertified, failures <= 10% of base and attempts -30%. Run the rival responses to the same failures (KRY-BUDGET-PREDICT, SOLVE-LIMITED-SWITCH, PC-LAGGED-HWINDOW) on the same cells at matched error.
candidates.fatal_vulnerability: No JVP-only upper bound on mu_D exists, so in the generic matrix-free setting the certificate is conditional on declared structure. On scale-disparate stiff chemistry the WRMS log-norm is orders of magnitude above the actual amplification, so the certificate degenerates to the tight fallback exactly where large-n Krylov cost matters (robertson-/hires-ramped). With an underestimated mu_hat the stall path turns a loud failure into a silent one; it must never run without a valid bound. Strongly nonnormal stalls (E-05 s = 10, 100) sit at O(1) residuals, B >> 1, no benefit.

candidates.title: Gustafsson-predictive step control with no growth after a rejection, adopted through a matched-accuracy regression frontier
candidates.mechanism: Error model err_n = phi_n h_n^5 (vdP same-state rejected/retry pairs give an observed exponent with median 4.95-4.99 at rtol <= 1e-4, so 1/5 is right where rejections happen). Current I controller (adaptive.rs:264-306): closed loop log err_{n+1} = log theta + Dlog phi_n with theta = 0.9^5 = 0.59, so a one-step growth of the error constant by more than 1/theta = 1.69 rejects, and after a rejection the accepted retry may grow 5x (F-078) and re-overshoot. Proposed (Hairer RODAS/RADAU5 PRED form, Gustafsson 1994): h_{n+1} = h_n*min{0.9 err_n^{-1/5}, 0.9 (h_n/h_{n-1})(err_{n-1}/err_n^2)^{1/5}}, both clamped to [0.2, 5], with factor <= 1 on the first acceptance after a rejection. Its loop is log err_{n+1} = log theta + (Dlog phi_n - Dlog phi_{n-1}), so it rejects only when the acceleration of log phi exceeds 0.53 (type-1 tracking of ramps). Both controllers have equilibrium err = 0.59 (verified from the formulas), so set-points match by construction. Matrix-free: rejected attempts are the largest-h attempts and Krylov work per attempt grows like h^0.6-0.7 (Bruss-160 replica 621 JVP/attempt at rtol 1e-6, 1042 at 1e-3), so removing rejections saves more than their share of attempts. candidates.mechanism: Replace J by the Krylov projection A = V H V^T on K_M(J, f0), extended by each stage RHS (Tranquilli, Glandon & Sandu 2021); the U-form stage is then exact and cheap: u_i = V(I/(h g) - H)^-1 V^T r_i + h g (I - V V^T) r_i, costing M JVPs per step and no GMRES. RODAS5P is only K-order 3 (lit-rok-w 0: its one extra order-4 K-tree has residual 1.1e-3), so its order collapses under this projection; ROK4a (Tranquilli-Sandu; OrdinaryDiffEq ROK4aRodasTableau, g = 0.5728, 4 stages) satisfies the TK conditions, so its nonstiff order 4 holds for any M >= 4. candidates.evidence_for: p6_rok.py: the contrast between RODAS5P-K silent error and ROK4a-K holding tolerance under the identical projection; 0.13x at matched error on Bruss-50; lit-rok-w 1-2 (K-order theory; RODAS5P K-order 3, W-order 2; ROWMAP dimensions 4-15).
candidates.evidence_against: p6b_rok.py and p6c_rok.py: Bruss-160 and nonnormal adv-diff silent excess of 2.5-400x without the gate; the gated version is untested; small-stiff losses (Robertson, HIRES, VdP); stiff rank k/n of 0.36-0.80 at R's h (p5_krank.py), although effective rank turned out lower on Bruss-50; the shared exact-image space (KRY-SHARED-SPACE) gets 0.28-0.42x on the Brusselators while keeping order 5, which narrows ROK's niche further.
candidates.prior_art_and_novelty: Tranquilli & Sandu SISC 36 (2014); Tranquilli, Glandon & Sandu JCAM 385 (2021); ROWMAP (Weiner, Schmitt & Podhaisky 1997); Buttner, Schmitt & Weiner 1995.
